title: Hash-Chained Audit Log
signature:
def append_event(chain, event) -> dict
def verify_chain(chain, head=None) -> int
hints: Canonical JSON means one byte string per event: json.dumps(event, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).
Store a deep copy of the event. If the caller reuses its dict after appending, your log must not change.
Verify three things per entry, in order: seq == index, prev_hash == the previous entry's stored hash, hash == recomputed hash. A rewritten tail only shows up against the published head.
